first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1266928 (Exeter Grammar School, Victoria Park Road, Exeter), bound to explicit school building identity/type-use evidence. Historic England's official NHLE record identifies Exeter Grammar School as a Grade II Listed Building and describes the L-shaped school block; the official Listed Building polygons FeatureServer layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer with ListEntry/Name/Grade fields, but the distinct exact-record GeoJSON query for ListEntry 1266928 was not retrievable through the available web channel and direct network resolution failed before any feature payload or polygon coordinates could be read. No footprint geometry was inferred or fabricated, so no individual building record was accepted.
